LIVE-EVIDENCE STATUS. The pre-fix baseline is now recorded, and the post-fix run is in flight.

BASELINE (the defect, observed live): GitHub Actions run 30763838558, job 'jira DC harness smoke
(real Jira Data Center, ephemeral)', job id 91538992083, against main @ 144bb02251 — which is BEFORE
this fix landed. Result: 2 failed, 47 passed in 1567.80s. One of the two failures is exactly this
defect:

    FAILED tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_mutations.py::test_outbound_mutation_round_trips[04-transition-status]
      - AssertionError: outbound status did not reach DC: fields.status.name is 'To Do'

That is the symptom this ticket was filed from, reproduced on a real Data Center instance with the
fix absent. It is the correct control: the cell fails for the stated reason, not for a setup error.

POST-FIX RUN IN FLIGHT: run 30765232591, dispatched against main @ 2ea5c3391d, which contains BOTH
of this ticket's commits (8961f12664 'extract DC transition cluster' and 2ea5c3391d 'route DC
outbound status to a transition') — verified present on origin/main and gerrit/main, and
adapters/jira_datacenter/transitions.py confirmed to exist in that tree. When it completes, read the
[04-transition-status] cell specifically rather than the pass/fail count; this epic's recurring
lesson is that 'N failed' is a category, not a cause.

NOTE ON THE OTHER FAILURE IN THE BASELINE RUN — it is NOT this ticket's. It is the inbound-assignee
cell, failing on its own SETUP precondition ('the store copy ALREADY maps jira/admin ... so a
mapping afterwards would prove nothing about this pass'). That is ticket 5200's rewritten oracle
correctly REFUSING TO PASS VACUOUSLY, which is the behaviour it was rewritten to have. It is tracked
on 5200 and does not affect this ticket's verdict.
